connector.name: Yandex Direct MCP by askads
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Yandex Direct API v5: manage PPC campaigns, ads, keywords, and statistics.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-yandex-direct. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the askads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_TOKEN
env.description: Yandex Direct OAuth token — full account access (can spend budget). Treat it as a secret.

env.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_LOGIN
env.description: Client login to target a specific account on agency tokens.

env.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_SANDBOX
env.description: Set to true to call the Yandex Direct sandbox API instead of production.

env.name: YANDEX_DIRECT_LANG
env.description: Language for API responses and error messages (ru, en, ...).
